name: Skeleton loader
looksLike: gray boxes that stand in for content while it loads
shimmering placeholder blocks shaped like the page
fake grey lines where text will appear
definition: Gray placeholder shapes that mimic the layout of content that is still loading, so the page doesn't jump when the real content arrives.
whenToUse: Lists, cards, and profiles loading from an API
Anywhere a spinner would feel slow or jumpy

prompts.short: Replace the list spinner with skeleton placeholders.
prompts.detailed: Replace the loading spinner with skeleton placeholders that match the final layout: a circle avatar and two text lines per row, a subtle shimmer animation, and no layout shift when real content loads. Respect prefers-reduced-motion.

vue: a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }
.placeholder { height: 80px; margin-block: 12px; background: currentColor; opacity: 0.15; border-radius: 8px; }

a11yNotes: Mark the loading region with aria-busy
Hide purely decorative placeholders from screen readers
